source.citation: Dicken SJ et al. Ultraprocessed or minimally processed diets following healthy dietary guidelines on weight and cardiometabolic health: a randomized, crossover trial. Nature Medicine 31, 3297-3308 (2025). DOI 10.1038/s41591-025-03842-0. Current Supplementary Table 5, PDF pages 12-13.
source.license_note: Article CC BY 4.0, third-party credit exception applies. Only attributed limited numerical facts distributed here; complete original PDF remains ignored by project choice.
source.correction_scope: Publisher identifies Table 24 energy-density correction; corrected current supplement selected. No claim of exhaustive revision history.

selection_chronology: Selected after text and visual inspection of published values and method footnote. Root independently visually checked both selected rows. Used-source reproduction, not preregistration.

source_method.method: paired t-test; baseline and between-diet change comparisons; no re-estimation

hba1c.source_locator: Supplementary Table 5, PDF page 12, HbA1C (%) row; ordered MPF / UPF / MPF-minus-UPF groups, N / Mean / SE columns

fasting_glucose.source_locator: Supplementary Table 5, PDF page 12, Fasting glucose (mmol/L) row; ordered MPF / UPF / MPF-minus-UPF groups, N / Mean / SE columns

limitations: Published ITT-labelled available-case unadjusted summaries; endpoint-specific N and paired N differ. Not an all-randomized-participant estimand.
Paired MPF-minus-UPF mean is the source value, not subtraction of separate marginal diet means.
Reported SE is rounded to one displayed decimal. A printed 0.0 does not identify zero uncertainty. No rounding rule, CI, sampling distribution or covariance is inferred.
Secondary biomarkers are exploratory; source tests were not adjusted for multiplicity. No significance reanalysis is performed.

Table 6 sequence/period and first-diet parallel contrasts remain documented, numerically unimplemented and distinct from this paired comparison. Carryover and missing-not-at-random selection are unresolved.
Assigned supplied dietary regimens meeting UK guidance are not an isolated UPF consumed-dose effect. No annualization, disease-state mapping, clinical hazard or U.S. transport.
The current article permits author-approved summary sharing only, not individual data. That does not negate these already public published aggregate tables.
Source-summary replay checks transcription/provenance, not model predictions, independent holdout validation or clinical scientific readiness.
attribution_changes: Limited numerical transcription; HbA1c level label (%) renamed to change unit percentage_points; group identifiers renamed. Source statistics and displayed precision unchanged. No original text/table/figures redistributed.
